There are no ownership gaps. All 76 elements in scope name an owner that resolves to a governance archetype through the role
registry — zero unresolved, and the suite gate asserts it on every build (OWNER-UNRESOLVED). This section is printed with its
zero rather than omitted: a missing ownership section reads as an analysis that was not done, and "no gaps found" and "not
looked for" are opposite findings that must not produce the same page.
